items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1961-06-06
items.q: Then later on I had Jay Golson... He was the arranger.

ctx.x: That was later then. That is correct. Much later. That's when it was first recorded. Paul Gayton is the one that put it on. Then later on I got Camille Howard to play it but she played it in the wrong vein. She played it in the jump tempo and You Don't Love Me isn't a jump song. It was the theme song of the band. Cottrell, myself and Lloyd Glenn. The pianist that was in my band. He came after Freeman didn't he? Long after Freeman. Yes he came quite a while after Freeman. I think that, I'm not for sure I think…
You had a regular arranger for your band?

items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1974-01-01
items.q: Jay Golson, who used to be a manager in my band in Detroit

ctx.x: And I just accidentally met him when I went to visit Jay Golson, who used to be a manager in my band in Detroit. And I also met Ziggy Johnson, who was the big director of the first year, was producer from Larry Steele. I always thought that Ziggy was even a better producer than Larry Steele was. He worked with him. He worked with him. Yes I did. Ziggy produced the shows when he was on the plantation club and I told him it was Bill A. Stein. He had come out of Washington, Pennsylvania and was singing with the…
G-I-G-G-Y. Just the same old word.

items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1973-08-06
items.q: Jay Golson was one of my arrangers.

ctx.x: He'd go there every night when Juanita would go off to play at this club. He'd go there and sit on the outside to keep Fats company. And Fats was on the last thing. Because he needed to see him alone.

Oh yeah. Well she would tell me to watch Fats. You know, I'd call her and she says, Come on over, I'm going to work. So I'd get over there and all the doors are locked. And so I'd go to the window and I'd eat that. I could raise his head up and tell him my cousin. I said, I don't worry about nothing. I said, if you get to the place where you really need me, I'm breaking the window. I said, well I need him locked all the house. When I'd come back she'd be all surprised. Thought she had left everything and all…
He never got the plan that the rest of his family did, huh?
